program.help:
Second-pass spike detection variant that runs threshold detection on the spatial-derivative + temporal first-difference signal (matching ndm_extractspikes_stderiv), then applies shadow-cluster assignment to the detected spikes in-place.
Detection thresholds are computed internally from the stderiv signal over the start..start+duration window using the Quiroga (2004) robust formula. Waveform extraction writes RAW ADC amplitudes so downstream feature projection matches the main pipeline's .spk.N.
Most parameters are inherited from ndm_extractspikes_stderiv: thresholdFactor, refractoryPeriod, peakSearchLength, start, duration, sdiffOrder.
The shadow-clustering stage is shared with ndm_reextractspikes — see that program's help for a description of reextractMinClusterSize, reextractChi2, and reextractExtraFeat.
OUTPUT
Merges in-place into $session.{res,spk,fet,clu}.N. Originals preserved at $session...bak on first run.
SEE ALSO
ndm_reextractspikes — raw-signal variant ndm_extractspikes_stderiv — first-pass stderiv detector
